big-five-to-the-indian-ocean.lead: Two Africas in one journey: leopard country on the Sabie River, then the granite islands of the Seychelles, joined by a single transformation day.

reasons.d: Five nights at Lion Sands with twice-daily drives led by FGASA-accredited rangers and Shangaan trackers. The islands are the reward for a proper safari, not a replacement for one.
Sabi Sand’s habituated leopards give long, close sightings rather than a glimpse, and a guided bush walk lets you read tracks, plants and geology at ground level.
Mahé’s culture, Praslin’s Vallée de Mai, Curieuse Island and La Digue, with stays at AQUA, Constance Lemuria and Six Senses Zil Pasyon.

bird-wildlife-quad.lead: A safari for people who look up as well as out: four of Kenya’s richest zones, with a specialist birding guide on every drive.

reasons.d: A specialist birding guide joins every drive, so the small species others roll past are never missed. Kenya has more than 1,100 recorded bird species.

reasons.t: Big game that holds its own
reasons.d: Amboseli’s elephants beneath Kilimanjaro, Solio Ranch’s rhino sanctuary and the Maasai Mara’s Big Five and cheetah keep non-birders fully absorbed.
A boat safari on Lake Nakuru’s flamingo-fringed shore, and a hot air balloon over the Mara at sunrise with a champagne bush breakfast.

botswana-desert-salt-pans-cultural-circu.lead: Botswana’s empty quarter: salt flats that run to the horizon, the remote Central Kalahari and guides whose knowledge goes back 20,000 years.

reasons.d: A hot air balloon over the Makgadikgadi Pans, the world’s largest salt flats, then a private helicopter to Kubu Island, an ancient granite outcrop rising from the pan floor.
Walking safaris with San Bushmen guides share tracking and plant knowledge built over millennia, in an exchange rather than a performance.

reasons.t: Five nights deep in the Kalahari
reasons.d: Tau Pan Lodge in the Central Kalahari Game Reserve, with night drives for bat-eared foxes, aardwolves and porcupines.

botswana-grand-safari.lead: Fifteen days from elephant country to the Chobe floodplains and Victoria Falls, with the flights and visa fees folded into one price.

reasons.d: Five nights at Mashatu Main Lodge, home to Africa’s largest elephants, plus the Matebole Underground Photo Hide and a horseback safari among ancient baobabs.
A hot air balloon over Chobe’s floodplains at sunrise with a champagne breakfast, and a private river safari along the Chobe among hippos and crocodiles.
A full-day excursion to one of the Seven Natural Wonders with visa fees included, a spa session on your return, and a flexible departure day.

botswana-water-wilderness-victoria-falls.lead: The Delta, Moremi and Chobe in ten days: Botswana’s water world seen from the air, from a boat and from the edge of Victoria Falls.

reasons.d: A hot air balloon over the Okavango Delta’s geometric channels at sunrise, then a private helicopter to Tsodilo Hills, Botswana’s only UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Three nights at &Beyond Sandibe, one of Africa’s most celebrated lodge designs, and four nights at Savute Safari Lodge where elephant herds gather by the hundred.
Motorised boat safaris through papyrus channels in the Delta and Moremi, the way to see sitatunga and red lechwe, and a full-day Victoria Falls excursion with visa included.

botswana-wilderness-immersion.lead: Fewer moves, more wilderness: fifteen days with a slow rhythm, nine of them in Chobe, and leisure days with nothing scheduled.

reasons.d: Several leisure days are built in, so there is time to watch, breathe and be present rather than race to the next transfer.
Chobe Game Lodge is the only permanent lodge inside Chobe National Park, on the river bank, with a private river safari and a sunrise balloon with champagne breakfast.
Four nights at Mashatu Main Lodge for walking safaris, the photographic hide at ground level, and full-day drives through the tri-border reserve.

conservation-royal-circuit.lead: Kenya’s conservation heartland: see the last northern white rhinos, sleep under the stars above Laikipia and learn how the land is protected.

reasons.d: A visit to the world’s last two northern white rhinos and East Africa’s largest black rhino sanctuary at Ol Pejeta, plus Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary, endorsed by the Jane Goodall Institute.

reasons.t: Safari on horse, camel and foot
reasons.d: Horseback and camel safaris and guided walks with armed conservancy rangers, and a balloon over the Lewa plateau with a champagne bush breakfast.
Loisaba’s famous raised star beds sit 500 feet above the Laikipia plains, the high point of three conservancies over twelve days.

east-african-grand-safari.lead: Thirty-one days across Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Tanzania, ending on Zanzibar: gorillas, chimpanzees, the Great Migration and Ngorongoro on one unbroken journey.

reasons.d: An hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family in Bwindi, and chimpanzee tracking in the sunken gorge of Kyambura and again in Nyungwe.
River crossings between July and October in both the Mara and the Serengeti, and a dawn balloon over the Mara with a champagne breakfast.
From Hemingways Nairobi to &Beyond Ngorongoro Crater Lodge and One&Only Nyungwe House, with tree-climbing lions in Ishasha and a Kazinga Channel boat safari on the way.

etosha-and-mauritius.lead: Namibia’s Etosha by private charter, then Mauritius for Le Morne, Chamarel and two of the island’s best-known resorts.

reasons.d: A private charter from Windhoek, three nights at Mokuti Etosha beside the Von Lindequist Gate, and twice-daily drives for lion, leopard, elephant and both white and black rhino.

reasons.t: Hai//om guides and a sky dinner
reasons.d: A morning bush walk with Hai//om guides, descendants of the region’s first hunter-gatherers, and dinner eight metres above the pan at SkyBoma.
Le Morne and the southwest, Chamarel and the Black River Gorges, Île aux Cerfs, and stays at Paradis Beachcomber and One&Only Le Saint Géran.

ewaso-nyiro-community-conservancies.lead: Northern Kenya’s dry country, where community conservancies, Samburu culture and desert-adapted wildlife take the place of the busy Mara circuit.

reasons.d: Guided walks along the river corridors with an expert Samburu tracker, a hot bush breakfast in a wilderness clearing and sundowners on the banks of the Ewaso Nyiro.
Three nights at Sasaab, a Moroccan-styled camp with thatched cottages and plunge pools, then Saruni Samburu, an eco-lodge on a volcanic rock face above Kalama.
Cheetah and desert antelope tracking in West Gate Conservancy, elephant in Samburu National Reserve, and a horseback trail ride ending in a starlit dinner.

grand-emperor-circle.lead: Five of Kenya’s best-known wildlife areas in twelve days, linked by private flights so the time goes to the animals rather than the road.

reasons.d: Tawi Lodge in Amboseli puts giant elephant herds in front of Mount Kilimanjaro.
A glass-fronted suite at Angama Mara, suspended above the Maasai Mara escarpment, with a dawn hot air balloon and champagne breakfast on the plains.
A horse-riding safari at Lewa alongside Grevy’s zebra and eland, and an exclusive visit to a local Maasai village.

great-migration-explorer.lead: A week with one purpose: following the Great Migration through the Maasai Mara, with no split destinations and no wasted transfer days.

reasons.d: Mara River crossing positions are followed daily across multiple herds with a specialist guide, so you are where the action is rather than guessing.
Ishara Mara is an intimate camp on the Talek River, with a private sundowner at the Mara Plains Scenic Overlook and a dawn balloon with champagne breakfast.
A night game drive for hyenas, civets and the Mara’s nocturnal predators, a conservancy walking safari and a Maasai cultural immersion.

great-tsavo-overland-expedition.lead: Tsavo is Kenya’s wild, less-visited giant: lava flows, natural springs and rhinos, seen from two very different camps.

reasons.d: A guided walk to Mzima Springs and a submerged viewing chamber where hippos glide past at eye level.
The black Shetani Lava Flow and the underground Leviathan Cave on foot, and a night drive with spotlights tracking leopards through the acacia.
Five nights at Finch Hattons beside a spring fed by the Chyulu Hills, then four nights at Satao Camp with a private viewing tower over a waterhole and a visit to the Ngulia Rhino Sanctuary.

kenya-family-safari-ol-pejeta-mount-keny.lead: A first family safari that pairs the world’s last two northern white rhinos with chimpanzees, a balloon flight and a horseback morning on Mount Kenya.

reasons.d: A guided visit to the last two northern white rhinos in existence, on Ol Pejeta’s 90,000 acres of Big Five, Grevy’s zebra, cheetah and endangered wild dog.
Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary, a dawn balloon over Laikipia with a champagne breakfast, and a chef-prepared bush lunch under an acacia.
Stay at the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, with a horseback safari, breakfast with the bongos and easy walks in the foothills.
